title.zh: 获取营销类型模板的相关指标

descriptions.zh:
- 此接口只能查询WhatsApp类型通道营销模板的相关指标。

- 在调用此接口前，请先调用[EnableWhatsAppROIMetric](~~2557789~~)接口开启WhatsApp ROI指标统计，开启后至少需一天才会有统计数据，开启前的营销模板相关指标将不进行统计。

- 开启WhatsApp ROI指标统计后，请确保您创建的通道的营销模板已有成功发送的消息。您可在<props="china">[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props>>**管理**>**消息发送**界面发送消息，或通过[SendChatappMessage](~~432208~~)、[SendChatappMassMessage](~~447926~~)接口发送消息。

### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- This operation can only query metrics for marketing templates of WhatsApp channels.

- Before calling this operation, call the [EnableWhatsAppROIMetric](~~2557789~~) operation to enable WhatsApp ROI metric collection. After enabling, statistical data requires at least one day to become available. Metrics for marketing templates sent before enabling are not collected.

- After enabling WhatsApp ROI metric collection, make sure that the marketing templates of your created channels have successfully sent messages. You can send messages on the <props="china">[**Channel Management**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">[**Channel Management**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props> > **Manage** > **Send Message** page, or by calling the [SendChatappMessage](~~432208~~) or [SendChatappMassMessage](~~447926~~) operation.

### QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 50 calls per second. Requests that exceed this limit are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation as appropriate.
